title: Tamil Nadu Holiday Announcement: Schools Closed Today In These Districts Amid Heavy Rain
text: The northeast monsoon has commenced in Tamil Nadu, bringing rainfall across various districts. In light of this, an orange alert has been issued for very heavy rainfall in the districts of Theni, Tenkasi, Tirunelveli, and Ramanathapuram. Heavy rain is also expected in the districts of Kanyakumari, Thoothukudi, Virudhunagar, Madurai, Sivaganga, Dindigul, Tiruppur, Coimbatore, the Nilgiris, and Erode. Likewise, reports indicate the likelihood of heavy rainfall in Kallakurichi, Villupuram, Chengalpattu, Kanchipuram, Chennai, Tiruvallur, Cuddalore, Mayiladuthurai, Nagapattinam, Thiruvarur, Thanjavur, and Pudukkottai districts. Meanwhile, in Tirunelveli district, roads have become waterlogged and muddy due to continuous rainfall over the past three days. Vehicular movement was disrupted by accumulated rainwater on the Washermanpet-Chellapandian flyover. Road workers were subsequently deployed to clear the water from the roads. Rainfall in the Western Ghats has also led to flooding in the Nambiar river. Due to heavy rainfall affecting paddy fields, a holiday has been declared for all schools in the district today. District Collector Sukumar has confirmed that all schools in the district will remain closed on October 16 due to the downpour, which has persisted since midnight. Similarly, the District Collectors of Thoothukudi and Tenkasi have announced a holiday for all schools in their respective districts owing to the heavy rainfall.
